clauses.reason: The single inventoried scope spans the whole operative body: provision 1-101 closes all Executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty on Friday, December 26, 1980; provision 1-102 lets agency heads keep offices open and employees at work on that date; provision 1-201 treats that date as a holiday for pay and leave. Every command names December 26, 1980 alone and was performed when that day ended, so the first end is 1980-12-26, recorded inclusive (the order operates through the day; the exclusive reading, ending when the day begins, cannot apply to a command to close on that day). The packet lookup of held texts citing this order by number found none.

research_rationale:
Identity confirmed against the census register (executive order of 1980-12-05 closing Government departments and agencies on Friday, December 26, 1980) and the held Federal Register text at 45 FR 80807, whose text layer shows Vol. 45, No. 237, Monday, December 8, 1980. The existing inventory scope covers the whole body of three provisions that all concern December 26, 1980; the first end is that date. No held text cites this order by number.
